# Introduction {-}

The code in this book creates 2 panel data sets: an individual level and a state level data set where each observation is at the NPI-time level. The data created in this book are the primary analysis data for a study looking at the impact of the NLC and other licensure policies on labor mobility.

The code from this book must be ran **after** the code from the book in the folder code/wrangling/survey-data as these data sets are merged into the panel data.

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  meassage = FALSE
  )
```
